title: Why Leaves Change Color: Yellow and Orange

scenes.title: HIDDEN COLORS
scenes.caption: Yellow pigments are present before autumn.
scenes.narration: Yellow pigments are already present in many green leaves.

scenes.title: MEET THE CAROTENOIDS
scenes.caption: Carotenoids create yellow and orange shades.
scenes.narration: Carotenoids create the yellow and orange autumn shades.

scenes.title: GOLDEN LEAVES
scenes.caption: Less chlorophyll lets yellow shine through.
scenes.narration: As chlorophyll fades, these golden colors become visible.

scenes.title: ORANGE IN THE CANOPY
scenes.caption: Some leaves show a blend of pigments.
scenes.narration: Some leaves show a beautiful blend of several pigments.

scenes.title: PIGMENTS AT WORK
scenes.caption: Carotenoids also help protect plant cells.
scenes.narration: Carotenoids also help protect leaf cells from excess light.

scenes.title: WHY COLORS VARY
scenes.caption: Each species has its own pigment balance.
scenes.narration: Different species contain different pigment balances.
